description: Operational dashboard for the Prometheus MCP Server
title: Prometheus MCP Server

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: One row per scraped server. During a rolling update the outgoing pod stays listed until its series go stale.

panels.title: Tool Call Rate
panels.description: Tool calls per second across the selected instances.

Share of tool calls that failed: tool results flagged isError, protocol errors (for example an unknown tool name) and unusable results. Calls canceled by the client are not failures, but they still count as calls.
panels.title: Tool Error Ratio
Tool Latency (p99)
panels.description: 99th percentile of tool-call duration across the selected instances. Includes the time spent waiting on Prometheus.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (tool_name) (histogram_count(increase(prom_mcp_tool_call_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))) or sum by (tool_name) (increase(prom_mcp_tool_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Tool vs Backend Latency (p50 / p99)
panels.description: Tool-call latency against the Prometheus API calls made on its behalf. The gap approximates the server's own cost (decode, truncation, serialisation); a tool call may issue more than one API call.
Average stop-the-world pause per GC cycle.
panels.title: GC Pause Duration (avg)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (prompt_name) (rate(prom_mcp_prompt_get_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le, prompt_name) (rate(prom_mcp_prompt_get_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (resource_uri) (rate(prom_mcp_resource_call_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le, resource_uri) (rate(prom_mcp_resource_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Time of the last successful docs auto-update. Reads 0 ("Never updated") until the first update succeeds, and stays 0 when --docs.auto-update is off.
panels.title: Last Docs Update
